title: Theorem
body_md: Let $\Omega$ be a $C^2$ bounded domain in the plane, or a surface without boundary, $\mathcal{M}$ be the space of measure-preserving homeomorphisms on $\Omega$  endowed with the $L^\infty$ topology and $L^1\cap\mathbf{Y}_{\Theta}$ be a Yudovich space  \eqref{Yspace}. Then the Euler solution map $S_{t,\omega_0, \Omega}:\mathcal{M}\rightarrow \mathcal{M} $ is well defined, $C^\infty$ smooth in time,  and  continuous  in its dependence on the initial data and domain (with a time-dependent modulus of continuity depending on $\Theta$).
